launch_authorization: v30 review and real-torch tests passed, but its frozen preparer refused duplicate 2023 export rows. User requested continuation. v31 changes only explicit source-row normalization and its independent audit; requires Codex tests, D0 and exact-source preflight before nine fits.
design_source: v29 results (c6e1b72): all-window training supported, state channels not; upstream MIDAS Open screen passed (0530a8f/cc7249c: lead 2-4 mean MAE/RMSE gain over the matched intercept+power-regime correction 3.48/3.11% in 2021 and 3.07/2.68% in 2022); user decisions 2026-10-27/28 (upstream observations next; MAE and RMSE/R2 both primary; use the data already downloaded); v30 preparation rejection audited before any 2023 model score, user continuation 2026-10-28
deviations: v29 rules.next_round named its validation-chosen Guard_last10_normal (chosen by MAE only). After the user's decision that MAE and RMSE are both primary, v30 starts from TSMixer_last10_all, the v29 arm best on RMSE/R2 (276.30 kW / 0.7725) and within 0.33 kW MAE of Guard on 2022; with all-window training the Guard rule is redundant. Disclosed, not hidden.
The upstream screen used a linear post-hoc correction; v30 feeds the same eleven features as input channels of the same TSMixer recipe. The screen is development evidence only.

v30 was committed as 09d1b2e and attempted preparation only: zero real fits or test model evaluations. Each 2023 turbine file has 2174760 rows at 52560 timestamps. Read-only audit found no multiple nonmissing values in the used columns. v31 selects one existing whole row that contains all known values at that timestamp, refuses any conflict or complementary rows, preserves every timestamp and missing-only labels, and never fills cells. Original archives and frozen v30 files are untouched. This is source-export normalization, not outcome-based filtering.
scope: one information group (upstream surface observations) on the v29 all-window TSMixer_last10 recipe, plus one loss-alignment arm; no Wiki; no novelty claim
questions: Q1 information: do the screened upstream station features, as input channels, improve TSMixer_last10_all on 2023 for BOTH MAE and RMSE?
Q2 loss: with the upstream channels, does a balanced 0.5 MAE + 0.5 MSE loss improve RMSE without worsening MAE beyond the non-inferiority margin?
Q3 naive: does the validation-chosen configuration beat the last-10-minute Persistence on 2023 for both metrics?
novelty_claim: none; TSMixer-basic and Persistence are published baselines; MIDAS Open are public observations

data.source: Zenodo 16807551, Kelmarsh six Senvion MM92, CC BY 4.0

v29_registered_preparation.use: identity reference only: every 2016-2022 row of the v30 preparation must equal this registered CSV, and the power curves must be identical

dataset.name: MIDAS Open UK hourly weather observations

upstream.test_access: test-year station files are opened only inside E1, after the S1 freeze; 2024 files are never opened
upstream.station_rule: the 36 stations qualified by the completed screen (150 km of Kelmarsh, hourly wind completeness >= 85% in every year 2016-2022); frozen below, never re-selected
upstream.feature_source: scripts/screen_kelmarsh_upstream_observations.upstream_features (screen-reviewed definitions), evaluated for every hourly label tau
upstream.timing: row with hour-end label tau uses observations at tau - 1 h (3-hour changes: tau - 1 h minus tau - 4 h); at issue time T the newest observation used is T - 1 h. Archival qc-version-1 values; real-time availability with a 1 h lag is an assumption, disclosed
upstream.parsing: screen rules: version_num 1 only, declared units (knots -> m/s; degrees; hPa), conflicting duplicates refused, file year = row year, SHA256 equal to the download manifest
upstream.missing_policy: input-only: a missing upstream feature is replaced by its training-year mean and the row is flagged in channel upstream_missing; labels are never filled; the window queue is exactly the SCADA-only queue

data.common_window_rule: ONE series is built with the union of all channels; the queue is defined by the SCADA channels and power (upstream channels are always finite after the input-only fill), so every arm uses exactly the same windows
data.scaler: mean/std of all training-year rows (ddof 0, NaN ignored) after the input-only upstream fill; SCADA channels identical to the provider scaler

v31_preparation.raw_reuse: after this protocol is frozen: hard-link the MD5-verified 2016-2022 archives and Kelmarsh_WT_static.csv from the v29 raw directory and the sealed datasets/upstream_observations/sealed/kelmarsh/Kelmarsh_SCADA_2023_5961.zip (MD5 685d9589347d1866f6f2cfe45b9af4f4) into datasets/wind_public_v31/resampled_hourly_scada/kelmarsh_multiyear/raw; never link or open the 2024 archive
v31_preparation.rule: prepared only after v31 is frozen; 2024 never prepared or read
v31_preparation.label_audit: scripts/audit_kelmarsh_multiyear_v31.py independently checks every turbine/year original power value, unique timestamps, missingness and strict six-tick hourly means; before S1 no test metric/model/selection

cohorts.all: every common window with original labels (deployment accuracy)
cohorts.normal: all four target hours are normal-operation hours (ex-post conditional cohort, secondary)
cohorts.reporting: every table reports BOTH cohorts; all is primary; abnormal operation is flagged in the data and never deleted

training.selection_metric: per fit: validation original-scale MAE on the 2022 ALL cohort (unchanged v28 fit_config)
training.tie_policy: strictly lower MAE updates; ties keep the earlier epoch
training.same_recipe_as: v29 TSMixer_last10_all (scripts/train_kelmarsh_multiyear_benchmark.fit_config, unchanged); only the balanced arm overrides the two loss weights

stages.name: data identity
stages.checks: v30 preparation metadata (years 2016-2023, curve 2016-2019, CSV hash); registered v29 CSV/metadata hashes; every 2016-2022 row equal to the v29 CSV; identical power curves; every development station file present with the manifest SHA256; series without the test year

stages.name: selection freeze
stages.freeze: selected states, validation metrics and the joint-score choice, written before any test file or window is opened

stages.name: single test evaluation
stages.content: open the 2023 station files (SHA256 against the manifest), rebuild the series with the test year, verify that every development input, label and the scaler are unchanged, predict every arm on both cohorts

validation_choice: among the three TSMixer arms: lowest joint score = seed-mean validation MAE / reference MAE + seed-mean validation RMSE / reference RMSE (reference TSMixer_last10_all, score 2); ties: fewer parameters, then protocol order

statistics.cohort: computed separately on test all and test normal
statistics.seed_handling: losses averaged over the 3 seeds on identical windows
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm over the C1-C3 MAE Newey-West p-values within each cohort; raw p retained
statistics.rmse: issue-time block bootstrap of squared-error sums; separate from the MAE CI

diagnostics.farm: farm-total (six-turbine sum) RMSE and MAE per lead on issue times with all six turbines in the ALL cohort, normalized by 6 x rated power; accuracy = 100% - normalized RMSE (descriptive; reference only to the NEA 2011 15% real-time guideline, which uses 15-minute resolution and opening capacity)
diagnostics.ensemble: 3-seed mean forecast of the validation-chosen arm (descriptive)

rules.upstream_information_supported: C1 on test all: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0 and Holm p <= 0.05 AND RMSE gain CI95 lower > 0; AND C1 on test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > -non_inferiority_margin_kw
rules.balanced_loss_supported: C2 on test all: RMSE gain CI95 lower > 0 AND MAE gain CI95 lower > -non_inferiority_margin_kw
rules.beats_naive: C3 on test all AND test normal: MAE gain CI95 lower > 0 and Holm p <= 0.05; AND on test all RMSE gain CI95 lower > 0
rules.attribution_limits: C1 adds twelve channels and 3864 parameters (4262 -> 8126); the upstream features are archival observations used with an assumed 1 h availability lag; C2 changes only the loss weights. No Wiki contribution or causal attribution is established.
rules.next_round: external validation on SDWPF full and Penmanshiel only after a separately frozen protocol (SDWPF KDD-version exposure must be disclosed); a further Kelmarsh information group confirms on 2024 under its own frozen protocol
rules.no_post_hoc: no arm, seed, epoch, threshold, station, feature or channel may be chosen from 2023 results

forbidden: preparing or reading 2024 (Kelmarsh or station files)
opening 2023 station files or test windows before the S1 freeze
selection, thresholds, stations or features from 2023
modifying v25-v29 files, the screen script or the registered preparations
modifying frozen v30 files; resolving conflicting nonmissing source values; coalescing complementary partial rows; dropping a timestamp or filling a missing-only label
